info.title: API.SH: Tokopedia
info.description: The Tokopedia API from API.SH: public Tokopedia data as clean JSON. Every endpoint is a GET with query parameters and your key in the x-api-key header. Calls that run cost the credits shown (x-credits): successes, and lookups that found nothing (404). Refused calls and errors on our side are free. Docs: https://api.sh/docs · Every platform: https://api.sh/openapi.json

get.description:
One Tokopedia product by link: name, price and label, original price, discount and campaign, stock, condition, status, minimum and maximum order, weight, creation date, units sold, rating, review count and rating breakdown, category path, description, specifications, images and videos, variants (options and each child's price, stock and link) and the shop. Also returns `wholesale_prices` (min_quantity, price tiers), `cashback_percent`, `cod`, `preorder`, `campaign_ends_at`, and `shop.official_store` / `shop.power_merchant`. `include=shop` adds the shop's stats to `shop` (location, city, shop_tier, rating, reviews, followers, products, products_sold, transactions, joined, open, avatar).

Every response includes `credits_used`: the credits this call cost.

Price: 1 credit per successful call. Docs: https://api.sh/docs/tokopedia-product

parameters.name: url
parameters.description: A tokopedia.com product link (/<shop>/<product>).

parameters.name: include
parameters.description: `shop` adds the shop's stats to `shop` (costs more).

200.description: The data as JSON (or CSV / NDJSON with `output`).

get.description:
Customer reviews of one Tokopedia product: rating, review text, date, product variant, reviewer name (as shown on the site), photo and video links, helpful count and the seller's reply. Filter by star rating, sort by newest, rating or helpfulness; paged.

Every response includes `credits_used`: the credits this call cost.

Price: 1 credit per successful call. Docs: https://api.sh/docs/tokopedia-reviews

parameters.name: product_id
parameters.description: Tokopedia product ID (the `id` of the product, shop products and search results).

parameters.name: url
parameters.description: A tokopedia.com product link, used when product_id is not given.

parameters.name: rating
parameters.description: Only reviews with this star rating (1-5).

parameters.name: sort
parameters.description: Review order (default relevance).

parameters.name: limit
parameters.description: Reviews per page (1-50, default 20).

parameters.name: page
parameters.description: Page number. Pass `next_page` from the previous response; `next_page` is null on the last page.

200.description: The data as JSON (or CSV / NDJSON with `output`).

get.description:
Products on Tokopedia (Indonesia) for keywords, with sort, price range, condition and an official-stores filter. Each product: id, name, link, price and label, original price and discount, price range, rating, review count, sold label, category path, labels, image and the shop (id, name, link, city, official and power-merchant flags). `total` is the site's count. Pass `next_page` back as `page`; null on the last page. Also filters by minimum `rating`, `shop_tier` (Official Store / Power Merchant) and shop city (`city_id`).

Every response includes `credits_used`: the credits this call cost.

Price: 1 credit per successful call. Docs: https://api.sh/docs/tokopedia-search

parameters.name: q
parameters.description: Keywords, e.g. `iphone`.

parameters.name: sort
parameters.description: relevance (default), newest, price_asc, price_desc, reviews.

parameters.name: price_min
parameters.description: Lowest price in rupiah.

parameters.name: price_max
parameters.description: Highest price in rupiah.

parameters.name: condition
parameters.description: new or used.

parameters.name: official
parameters.description: true = official stores only.

parameters.name: page
parameters.description: Page number. Pass `next_page` from the previous response.

parameters.name: rating
parameters.description: Minimum star rating, 1 to 5 (e.g. `4` for 4 stars and up).

parameters.name: shop_tier
parameters.description: Shop tier, comma-separated for several: `official` (Official Store), `power_merchant` (Power Merchant).

parameters.name: city_id
parameters.description: Tokopedia city ids of the shop location, comma-separated (e.g. `174,175,176,177,178,179` for the Jakarta cities).

parameters.name: shop_id
parameters.description: Only products from these shops (numeric shop ids, comma-separated, up to 10), e.g. the shop id in a result.

parameters.name: category_id
parameters.description: Only this category (the site's numeric category id, sc= in its links); q may be left out to list the category.

200.description: The data as JSON (or CSV / NDJSON with `output`).

The products of one Tokopedia shop: id, name, link, price, original price and discount, rating, review count, image, labels and stock flags. Search within the shop, filter by price range, sort by relevance, best selling or price; paged.

Every response includes `credits_used`: the credits this call cost.

Price: 1 credit per successful call. Docs: https://api.sh/docs/tokopedia-shop-products

parameters.name: price_max

apiKey.name: x-api-key
apiKey.description: Create keys at https://app.api.sh/keys. Authorization: Bearer <key> also works.

raw.name: raw
raw.description: 0 leaves out the bulky `raw` source blocks (often 10-30x smaller).

fields.name: fields
fields.description: Comma-separated fields to return, e.g. `posts.id,posts.title`. Call metadata is always included.

fresh.name: fresh
fresh.description: 1 skips the 24-hour cache and fetches live.

output.name: output
output.description: csv or ndjson returns the response's records (its main list, or the object as one row) as CSV or NDJSON instead of JSON.

records.name: records
records.description: With output=csv|ndjson: the top-level list to turn into rows (e.g. `reviews`), or `.` for the whole object as one row.

status_url.description: On a 503 for a paused endpoint: the status page, which lists open incidents.

E400.description: A parameter is missing or invalid. Not charged (unless the call ran and the source rejected the value; credits_used says).

E401.description: Missing, invalid, revoked or expired API key. Not charged. See https://api.sh/docs/errors#401

E402.description: Not enough credits, a spend limit you set was reached (`spend_limit`), or the key's monthly credit cap was reached (`key_cap`). Not charged.

E404.description: Not found, or not public. A lookup that ran costs the endpoint's price (credits_used says); an unknown route is free.

E502.description: The source site failed this time; retry. Not charged.

E503.description: Endpoint paused or temporarily unavailable; may include retry-after, and status_url (https://api.sh/status) for a paused endpoint. Not charged.
